title: A Universal Time Script | Free Boundless Tower, Auto Farm
features:
etler hub, an automation hub for a universal time
boundless tower is fully free, and it also farms mobs and bosses, does quests, and keeps going while you're out

getting your key

run the script and a box pops up, click "get a key" (the link gets copied), open it in your browser, sign in with discord, then paste the key back in the box and hit continue, takes about a minute, the key is free and lasts 48h, and the script remembers it so you never have to edit anything

- farms chainsaw hybrid and the other new combat specs too, a lot of scripts just don't attack with them

- teleports, combat helpers, quick menus, save/load configs and a search bar that finds any option by name
